items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: And it was just a four piece outfit with Alvin Torniette who we used when we could on trumpet.

ctx.x: Well, these people in Lake Chaucer, did they have a name?

Ham Crawford Orchestra No. 2 is the number that, is the name we went under there because we were still supposed to be working for Ham. We played Shell Beach, Pleasure Pier. We played Big Lake out from Lake Charles. We played, we played Jennings, all the little towns surrounding Lake Charles. And it was just a four piece outfit with Alvin Torniette who we used when we could on trumpet. And so we had five pieces really. And then, I think I mentioned that they had little black bands who played ballyhood for, they…
Did you know Nellie Lutcher on Lake Charles?
